mechanism.claim: A strong completed-hour BTCUSDT aggressive-flow impulse while BTCUSDC and BTCFDUSD remain quiet identifies dominant-book price discovery. If perpetual OI contracts while both BVOL and DVOL expand, old leveraged inventory is being removed during a new volatility impulse; the USDT flow direction should relay for six hours.
mechanism.side: sign of current-hour BTCUSDT robust flow z-score
mechanism.why_distinct: DQDIR is a dominant USDT-book impulse with both alternative books quiet, negative OI change, and joint volatility expansion. VGSQF required alternative-book consensus, USDT lag, participation, and high volatility levels; HVOPCR used BTC price direction rather than quote flow.
mechanism.why_low_gross9_overlap_is_plausible: quote-denomination topology fused with perp inventory contraction and cross-venue volatility ignition is absent from Gross9

clock.decision: T after a completed UTC source hour
clock.normalization: per-book robust z=(imbalance-prior720h q50)/((q75-q25)/1.349), shifted one hour, minimum 672; zero scale invalid
clock.oi_deleveraging: raw-time backward-asof positive BTCUSDT OI at T and T-60m, age<=5m, current/prior-1 strictly negative
clock.volatility_ignition: normalized completed-hour BVOL and DVOL bodies are both strictly positive
clock.trigger: false-to-true onset with prior source-valid consecutive hour
clock.reservation: global half-open, exit first on equal open
clock.funding: not a signal input; exact settlements only for later PnL
